clips.title: The story
paras: In Menethil Harbor, James Halloran makes a living tanning crocolisk hides. Passing travelers and nearby trade channels help him gather raw skins and carry finished leather to buyers across the eastern continents.

James Halloran lives and works in Menethil Harbor, earning his living from the marsh just outside town. The dangerous bogs provide crocolisk skins, which he turns into fine leather through rare craftsmanship. Nearby trade channels carry his finished goods to buyers across Azeroth.

Halloran tends his curing vats and trade arrangements near the marsh, where danger is constant. He hires hardy travelers to skin young marsh beasts and handle routine deliveries between his work site and nearby settlements. Their help keeps his leather craft supplied while he manages the tanning and trade.
